sources.title: Google Scholar
sources.snippet: Google Scholar provides a simple way to broadly search for scholarly literature. Search across a wide variety of disciplines and sources: articles, theses, books, abstracts and court opinions.

sources.title: Papers | Prompt Engineering Guide
sources.snippet: The following are the latest papers (sorted by release date) on prompt engineering for large language models (LLMs). We update the list of papers on a daily/weekly basis.

sources.title: Prompt Engineering Guide | Prompt Engineering Guide
sources.snippet: Motivated by the high interest in developing with LLMs, we have created this new prompt engineering guide that contains all the latest papers, advanced prompting techniques, learning guides, model-specific prompting guides, lectures, references, new LLM capabilities, and tools related to prompt engineering.

sources.title: Prompt Engineering Papers Collection | dair-ai/Prompt-Engineering-Guide ...
sources.snippet: This page documents the Prompt Engineering Papers Collection, a comprehensive catalog of research papers focused on prompt engineering techniques, methodologies, and applications for large language models (LLMs). The collection is maintained in pages/papers.en.mdx 1-600 and updated on a daily to weekly basis with newly published research.

sources.title: Prompt Engineering a Prompt Engineer
sources.snippet: In this paper, we introduced three meta-prompt components that lead to improved performance on automatic prompt engineering. The resulting method PE2 refines prompts written by human ex-perts and surpasses established automatic prompt engineering baselines across various scenarios, no-tably on counterfactual tasks and a production ap-plication.
